german.line: Hear them whispering French and German
stanza: Hear them whispering French and German
When no one's looking, I touch a sculpture
Marble, cold, and soft as satin

sermon.line: And I gotta hear the same sermon
stanza: The spin of the earth impaled a silhouette
Of the sun on the steeple
And I gotta hear the same sermon
All the time now from you people:
